name: @extas/creative-studio
description: S25 · Video & Campaign Creative Studio (PR 481–490): the action/motion library (PR 481), the image-to-video engine with its provider adapter and best-of-2 (PR 482–484), reel assembly with music, text, logo and aspect variants (PR 485–486), campaign creative export in every platform size (PR 487–488), the page-level time-bound campaign overlay (PR 489) and the creative brief with its three-direction grooming flow (PR 490). Every clip is image-to-video from an already-approved still, never text-to-video (Blueprint C8.1); every generation is priced and logged to the shared AI usage ledger before it runs.
